negative.meaning: ratingChange's negative flag: true means eloB should decrease and eloA should increase; false means eloA should decrease and eloB should increase
negative.checkpoint: returned by Elo.ratingChange before battleElo applies the update

elo_a_delta_direction_correct.meaning: the applied update moves eloA in the report-required direction: increase when negative is true, decrease when negative is false
elo_a_delta_direction_correct.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative to eloA

elo_b_delta_direction_correct.meaning: the applied update moves eloB in the report-required direction: decrease when negative is true, increase when negative is false
elo_b_delta_direction_correct.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative to eloB

assumptions: battleElo calls Elo.ratingChange once per battle and applies the returned change and negative to eloA and eloB.
The report's required direction is: negative true => eloB decreases and eloA increases; negative false => eloA decreases and eloB increases.

unresolved.description: No concrete numeric change values or magnitudes are given, so the direction relation is encoded as grounded Boolean direction-correctness observables rather than numeric deltas.

limitations: Direction-correctness Booleans must later be bound to the actual applied delta signs in code; the report supplies no numeric deltas.
Only the i_direction_wrong impact is formalized; better-party decrease, worse-party increase, and downstream protocol harms are handled in separate passes.
